description: This file defines the WaypointCircuit class used for managing and interpolating waypoints along a circuit, including visualization in the Unity editor. It includes methods for calculating route positions, caching waypoint data, and drawing gizmos. It also contains nested classes for waypoint list management and custom editor drawer for Unity inspector.

classes.name: WaypointCircuit
classes.description: Manages a circuit of waypoints, providing position interpolation, visualization, and route calculations.

classes.name: WaypointCircuit.WaypointList
classes.description: Holds a list of waypoint transforms associated with a circuit.

classes.name: WaypointCircuit.RoutePoint
classes.description: Struct representing a position and direction on the route.

classes.name: UnityStandardAssets.Utility.Inspector.WaypointListDrawer
classes.description: Custom inspector drawer for editing waypoint lists in Unity editor.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Initializes the circuit, caching waypoint positions and distances if more than one waypoint exists.

methods.name: GetRoutePoint
methods.description: Returns a RoutePoint (position and direction) at a specified distance along the circuit.

methods.name: GetRoutePosition
methods.description: Calculates the position on the route at a given distance, with optional smoothing.

methods.name: CatmullRom
methods.description: Calculates a point on a Catmull-Rom spline given four control points and an interpolation factor.

methods.name: CachePositionsAndDistances
methods.description: Precomputes waypoint positions and cumulative distances for efficient lookup.

methods.name: OnDrawGizmos
methods.description: Draws gizmos in the editor for visualizing the circuit.

methods.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
methods.description: Draws gizmos when the object is selected.

methods.name: DrawGizmos
methods.description: Handles the actual drawing of the circuit in the editor, with optional smoothing.
